questions.text: A win scores 2, a loss 1, no ties. A team played 22 games for 40 points. How many wins?
questions.textZh: 篮球联赛每场必分胜负，胜一场得 2 分，负一场得 1 分。某队 22 场得 40 分，胜了几场？

questions.text: How many pairs of positive whole numbers solve 2x + y = 7?
questions.textZh: 方程 2x + y = 7 有几组正整数解？

questions.text: 30 tickets sold: adults 50 yuan, students 30 yuan, 1140 yuan in all. How many adult tickets?
questions.textZh: 电影院售出成人票和学生票共 30 张，成人票 50 元、学生票 30 元，共收入 1140 元。成人票卖了多少张？

questions.text: Chickens and rabbits: 35 heads, 94 feet. How many rabbits?
questions.textZh: 鸡兔同笼，上有 35 头，下有 94 足。兔有多少只？

questions.text: 30 big + 15 small cows eat 675 kg a day; 42 big + 20 small eat 940 kg. How many kg does one big cow eat?
questions.textZh: 30 头大牛和 15 头小牛每天用饲料 675 kg；42 头大牛和 20 头小牛每天用 940 kg。每头大牛每天用多少千克？

questions.text: 2 big + 3 small trucks carry 15.5 t; 5 big + 6 small carry 35 t. How many tonnes do 3 big + 5 small carry?
questions.textZh: 2 辆大车和 3 辆小车一次运 15.5 t，5 辆大车和 6 辆小车一次运 35 t。3 辆大车和 5 辆小车一次运多少吨？

questions.text: Uphill 30, flat 40, downhill 50 km/h. There via uphill + flat takes 54 min, back via downhill + flat 42 min. Total km?
questions.textZh: 上坡 30、平路 40、下坡 50（km/h）。去时上坡加平路用 54 min，回来下坡加平路用 42 min。全程多少千米？

questions.text: Two barns hold 450 t. After 60% leaves barn 1 and 40% leaves barn 2, barn 2 has 30 t more. How much did barn 1 hold?
questions.textZh: 两座仓库共存粮 450 t。1 号运出 60%、2 号运出 40% 后，2 号比 1 号多剩 30 t。1 号原来存粮多少吨？

questions.text: Markers cost 5 yuan, gel pens 3 yuan; 19 yuan buys some of each. How many markers?
questions.textZh: 记号笔 5 元一支，中性笔 3 元一支，共花 19 元，两种都买了。买了几支记号笔？

questions.text: Water: tier 1 up to 12 m³, then tier 2. 14 m³ costs 37.6 yuan, 17 m³ costs 47.2. Tier 2 price per m³?
questions.textZh: 阶梯水价：12 m³ 以内按一级价，超出部分按二级价。用水 14 m³ 缴 37.6 元，17 m³ 缴 47.2 元。二级单价每立方米多少元？

questions.text: On a loop, two runners meet every 2 min running opposite ways and every 6 min the same way. Minutes per lap for the faster one?
questions.textZh: 环形跑道上两人反向跑每 2 min 相遇一次，同向跑每 6 min 相遇一次。快的人跑一圈要几分钟？

questions.text: Tens digit = 2 × hundreds; 3 × hundreds − ones = tens / 4; digits sum to 11. What is the number?
questions.textZh: 一个三位数：十位是百位的 2 倍，百位的 3 倍减个位等于十位的 1/4，各位数字之和为 11。这个三位数是多少？

questions.text: x/2 = y/3 = z/4 and 2x − y + 2z = 27. What is z?
questions.textZh: 已知 x/2 = y/3 = z/4，且 2x − y + 2z = 27，z 等于多少？

questions.text: x + y = 3, y + z = 4, z + x = 5. What is x + y + z?
questions.textZh: 已知 x + y = 3，y + z = 4，z + x = 5，x + y + z 等于多少？

questions.text: A car must cover more than 210 km in 2 h. Its speed must be above how many km/h?
questions.textZh: 汽车要在 2 h 内驶过 210 km 以上，车速要超过每小时多少千米？

questions.text: Solve x − 7 > 26. The solution is x > ?
questions.textZh: 解不等式 x − 7 > 26，解集是 x > 多少？

questions.text: Solve (2/3)x > 50. The solution is x > ?
questions.textZh: 解不等式 (2/3)x > 50，解集是 x > 多少？

questions.text: What is the largest whole number with 3(x − 1) < x + 6?
questions.textZh: 3(x − 1) < x + 6 的最大整数解是多少？

questions.text: 20 questions: +10 right, −5 wrong or blank. More than 90 points to advance. At least how many right?
questions.textZh: 古诗词竞赛共 20 题，答对得 10 分，答错或不答扣 5 分，得分超过 90 分才能晋级。至少要答对几题？

questions.text: Shop A: 10% off past 100 yuan. Shop B: 5% off past 50 yuan. Above how many yuan is shop A cheaper?
questions.textZh: 甲超市累计购物超过 100 元后超出部分打九折，乙超市超过 50 元后超出部分打九五折。累计超过多少元时去甲超市更省？

questions.text: How many whole numbers satisfy both 5x + 2 > 3(x − 1) and x/2 − 1 ≤ 7 − 3x/2?
questions.textZh: 同时满足 5x + 2 > 3(x − 1) 和 ½x − 1 ≤ 7 − (3/2)x 的整数有几个？

questions.text: 3 books each leaves 8 over; at 5 each the last student gets some but fewer than 3. How many books?
questions.textZh: 分书：每人 3 本还剩 8 本；如果每人 5 本，最后一人能分到但不足 3 本。一共有多少本书？
